attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yedI`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.05 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 9 to 88%, 71 persistent and 8 shell, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 35% of calls. The `fliR` to `fliE` genes, columns 7 to 20, are [[flagellar biosynthesis]]. A branch of 4 shell families runs through columns 21 to 24, `emrE` to `insQ`, in 14 to 34%.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 88%, and hesitates less there, 0.05 against 0.52 bits. Its most hesitant column, 21, `yedK`, is a fork column, at 1.59 bits.

**The window ends on a fork column.** Column 79, `cmoA`, is carried by 32% of chromosomes. It is not rare: in the other chromosomes it lies beyond the window's end.

**Across the window it names 88% of genes**, 0.52 bits on average, perplexity 2.0 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.90 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 57% against 94%.

label: yedI
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yedI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yedI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,772 to 1,851 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yedI once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.52 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,513 calls, named 98%, 0.19 bits; shell 9,371 calls, named 62%, 1.29 bits; cloud 1,156 calls, named 14%, 3.51 bits. Outside an RGP 35,957 calls, named 94%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 7,083 calls, named 57%, 1.90 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 34 fork, 45 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.90 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (57% against 94%); 7,083 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 21 (yedK, a fork column) 1.59 bits, RGP 35%; column 46 (yecR, a fork column) 0.81 bits, RGP 32%; column 44 (yecH, a fork column) 0.81 bits, RGP 27%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.05 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 88%, 0.52 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 21, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yedI "DUF808 domain-containing protein". named 99%; 0.05 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 9-88%, 71 P, 8 S, RGP 0.2-35%. named 61-99% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 21, named 61%, 1.59 bits.
